4.title: crossing and merging at a junction; four-way contention (tile granularity 1-4)

fresh_seeds.bound_weighted_note: Clopper-Pearson upper limit on the effective sample: n_eff = (sum w)^2 / sum w^2 = 4580.4; effective violation count x_eff = n_eff x (weight of the violating encounters / sum w) = 0.219, rounded up to 1; weighted point rate 4.78e-05. E44's rule (unweighted Clopper-Pearson on n_driven once x > 0) gives 'bound' above, which is below the zero-violation bound on n_eff and so not comparable with it

replay.what_happened: a vehicle held at the zone boundary (it could not cross before the closure) kept its grant for a one-lane resource beyond the zone, and a vehicle inside the zone waited at that resource's stop line and was still inside when the zone closed (hold-and-wait between R5 and R3)
replay.variant: a vehicle requests a resource only when no hold point it cannot pass (a closed or closing landing zone) lies before that resource
replay.scope_note: only this one encounter of the 10,000 fresh type-6 encounters was rerun under the variant; nothing is claimed about the variant on the others (E44's own variant run used the main-run seeds)
